scripts.copy-data: mkdir -p public/data && cp ../data/summary.json ../data/intersections.geojson public/data/ && (cp ../data/bogota_zats.geojson public/data/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../data/segments.geojson public/data/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../data/bogota_segments.geojson public/data/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp ../data/imagery_scores.json public/data/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:static: npm run copy-data && NEXT_OUTPUT=export next build
scripts.build:pages: npm run copy-data && NEXT_OUTPUT=export NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/walksafe-ai-dashboard next build
scripts.preview:static: npm run build:static && npx serve out
scripts.preview:pages: npm run build:pages && rm -rf .preview && mkdir -p .preview/walksafe-ai-dashboard && cp -r out/. .preview/walksafe-ai-dashboard/ && echo '\nOpen http://localhost:3000/walksafe-ai-dashboard/\n' && npx serve .preview
